params.name: app_id
params.description: The app ID that you want to view notifications from

params.name: limit
params.description: How many notifications to return.  Max is 50.  Default is 50.

params.name: offset
params.description: Page offset.  Default is 0.  Results are sorted by queued_at in descending order.  queued_at is a representation of the time that the notification was queued at.

params.name: kind
params.description:
Kind of notifications returned:
  * unset - All notification types (default)
  * `0` - Dashboard only
  * `1` - API only
  * `3` - Automated only

Generate a compressed CSV report of all of the events data for a notification.
This will return a URL immediately upon success but it may take several minutes for the CSV to become available at that URL depending on the volume of data. Only one export can be in-progress per OneSignal account at any given time.
